name: Black Iron Executor
loreTies: A sanctioned executioner whose brutality is bureaucratic: once the contract permits violence, it becomes inevitable.
Elite burst threat with telegraphed lethal windows.
source culture humans later copied as hell, demonology, and infernal contract lore
shortBackstory: Black Iron Executor is a lore-faithful Infernal Dominion run-in creature used when missions or events justify faction contact without rewriting the faction or creating playable squads.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Black Iron Executor belongs to The Infernal Dominion and exists to express Infernal Dominion law, pressure, or defense during Gate instability.

chapters.title: Faction Function
chapters.text: Elite burst threat with telegraphed lethal windows.

chapters.title: Lore Guardrail
chapters.text: Do not use as a generic monster; keep faction law, materials, motives, and silhouette intact.

chapters.title: Campaign Use
chapters.text: It may appear in enemy-controlled zones, border conflicts, Gate events, pursuits, trials, bargains, or defensive reactions when the mission gives a lore-valid reason.

chapters.title: Visual / Encounter Rule
chapters.text: Visuals must follow: Towering black iron knight, execution brand axe, furnace chest, crimson wax seals. Abilities — Execution Arc, Sentence Mark, Furnace Guard — must telegraph clearly for mobile one-Deity-vs-many combat.

developmentStatus: Readable faction run-in creature profile integrated into mission/event encounter pools.
